caveats: Rewrites in place on Desktop and Web; on mobile the pill opens a sheet instead.
Reads the Composer through its DOM or React tree, so a Paseo UI update can break it.
Never sends on its own: you review the rewrite and send it yourself.
Direct API calls do not stream and hit the daemon's 30-second plugin-call cap.
API endpoints use a static key read from an environment variable or secrets.json; no OAuth.
Provider CLI mode needs that provider's CLI on the Paseo daemon's PATH.
